```yaml
lines:
  - id: f2441.h_qp_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying persons listed on line 2"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
    note: "Only qualifying persons in the dependent collection are counted. A disabled spouse who is a qualifying person has no entry in the supplied interface, so the spouse is not counted."

  - id: f2441.line2_box
    printed: "2 (box)"
    label: "If you have more than three qualifying persons, see the instructions and check this box"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [f2441.h_qp_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}

  - id: f2441.h_paid_total
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Total of the qualified expenses incurred and paid in 2025 for the qualifying persons (column (d) before any reduction for benefits)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.dc_paid
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
    note: "Column (d) is built from dependent.dc_paid, not from dependent.dc_line2d. The dc_paid input includes expenses paid with dependent care benefits and says Form 2441 subtracts the benefits; that subtraction is made at line 30 (line 28 benefits)."

  - id: f2441.h_two_or_more
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Two or more qualifying persons"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, ge: [f2441.h_qp_count, {param: dc.persons_two}]}

  - id: f2441.h_limit_one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$3,000 (one qualifying person)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: dc.limit_one}

  - id: f2441.h_limit_two
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$6,000 (two or more qualifying persons)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: dc.limit_two}

  - id: f2441.h_dollar_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$3,000 if one qualifying person, $6,000 if two or more"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.h_two_or_more, {const: true}]}
          then: f2441.h_limit_two
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.h_two_or_more, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_limit_one

  - id: f2441.h_line3_capped
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Column (d) total, not more than $3,000 (one qualifying person) or $6,000 (two or more)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [f2441.h_paid_total, f2441.h_dollar_limit]}

  - id: f2441.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Add the amounts in column (d) of line 2. Don't enter more than $3,000 if you had one qualifying person or $6,000 if you had two or more persons. If you completed Part III, enter the amount from line 31"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.benefits, {const: true}]}
          then: f2441.line31
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.benefits, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_line3_capped
    note: "Part III is completed exactly when dependent care benefits were received (Part I: 'Did you receive dependent care benefits? Yes: Complete Part III')."

  - id: f2441.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Enter your earned income. See instructions"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.dc_earned
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.role, {const: "taxpayer"}]}
    note: "Deemed earned income of $250/$500 a month for a student or disabled filer cannot be figured: the interface supplies no month counts. Only actual earned income (person.dc_earned) is used."

  - id: f2441.h_spouse_earned
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Spouse's earned income (credit)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.dc_earned
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.role, {const: "spouse"}]}

  - id: f2441.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "If married filing jointly, enter your spouse's earned income (if you or your spouse was a student or was disabled, see the instructions); all others, enter the amount from line 4"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [f2441.spouse_died, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_spouse_earned
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [f2441.spouse_died, {const: true}]}
          then: f2441.line4
        - guard: {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
          then: f2441.line4
    note: "Pub. 503 says a surviving spouse filing jointly may, but isn't required to, take into account the deceased spouse's earned income. The favorable choice of leaving it out (line 4 repeated) is used. Deemed student/disabled income cannot be figured: there are no month counts."

  - id: f2441.line16
    printed: "16"
    label: "Enter the total amount of qualified expenses incurred in 2025 for the care of the qualifying person(s)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f2441.h_paid_total, f2441.other_care_expenses]}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits

  - id: f2441.line18
    printed: "18"
    label: "Enter your earned income. See instructions"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.dc_earned_b
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.role, {const: "taxpayer"}]}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    note: "person.dc_earned_b is read as earned income without the dependent care benefits on line 12 (instructions for line 18). Deemed student/disabled income cannot be figured: there are no month counts."

  - id: f2441.h_spouse_earned_b
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Spouse's earned income (benefits)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.dc_earned_b
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.role, {const: "spouse"}]}

  - id: f2441.line19
    printed: "19"
    label: "Enter the amount shown below that applies to you. If married filing jointly, enter your spouse's earned income. If married filing separately, see instructions. All others, enter the amount from line 18"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
          then: f2441.h_spouse_earned_b
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [household.considered_unmarried, {const: true}]}
          then: f2441.line18
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [household.considered_unmarried, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_spouse_earned_b
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
              - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
          then: f2441.line18
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    note: "Open point: the interface has no input for the 'considered unmarried' test that Form 2441 sets for married filing separately (lived apart the last 6 months, home of a qualifying person for over half the year, paid over half the upkeep). The closest supplied fact, household.considered_unmarried (the head-of-household test), is used. If no spouse entry exists, the spouse's earned income totals zero. Deemed student/disabled income cannot be figured."

  - id: f2441.line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Enter $3,000 ($6,000 if two or more qualifying persons)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f2441.h_dollar_limit}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits

  - id: f2441.line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "Complete line 2 on page 1 of this form. Don't include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28 above. Then, add the amounts in column (d) and enter the total here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f2441.h_paid_total, take: f2441.line28}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    note: "The paid expenses include those paid with dependent care benefits (dependent.dc_paid). Leaving out the benefits shown on line 28 is applied once to the total, with zero as the floor."

The closest supplied fact, household.considered_unmarried (the head-of-household test), is used. If no spouse entry exists, the spouse's earned income totals zero. Deemed student/disabled income cannot be figured.
